name: Fundamentals of Capillarity and Wetting
description: Fundamentals of molecular interactions, surface tension, capillary forces, capillary rise, deformable interfaces, capillary waves, lubrication, contact angles and hysteresis, contact line motion, Young-Laplace equation, three phase equilibrium, wetting and long-range forces, wetting on heterogeneous surfaces, wetting at soft interfaces, effective interface potential, hydrodynamics of interfaces, friction and lubrication, surface waves, viscous and inertial dewetting, super-hydrophobicity, gravity and electric field, basics of electrowetting.
